GH-1494 (the roadmap sync). The roadmap.yaml change is a mechanical github-to-yaml sync. I grepped every removed line of the form `-  <key>:`: all 167 are `updated:`, `release:` or `status:` changes. No item, acceptance criterion or note is deleted. Statuses change in exactly five places: four planned→cancelled and one inprogress→completed (PMAT-1299). The orphan GitHub rows GH-1500…GH-1546, PMAT-1530 and PMAT-1548 are appended. The receipt quotes the raw `pmat comply check --checks CB-2113,CB-2115` output for this branch: CB-2113 passes (9/9 trailered), and CB-2115 passes with 165 open items and 165 open issues matched, 0 tolerated. That meets the ticket's own acceptance criterion.

Scope widening (PMAT-1530 and PMAT-1548 stacked in). This is disclosed, not hidden:
- The receipt quotes the cop's APPROVED ruling, which itself requires this combined-diff quorum.
- Each part carries its own agreed 3-PASS receipt, judged by non-author lanes. The author is claude-sonnet-5-5 and is excluded in both.
- The stacked hunks match what those quorums approved: one statement-scoped `#[allow(clippy::clone_on_copy)]` with a reason, seven patch-level lockfile bumps, and four RUSTSEC ignores, each with a reason in both deny.toml and .cargo/audit.toml.

No test is weakened or inverted, and no CI or workflow file is touched. I ran no build. I could not run git (no shell in this lane), so I could not check byte-for-byte that the stacked hunks equal the parts' own diffs. That match is cited from the hunks, not measured.

The change is disclosed (receipt part 3) and has a non-author sign-off (quorum-PMAT-1548.json, agreed: true, plus this combined round bound to the final commit), so no gate is hidden or waived. The previous round's lane 1 raised the same wording issue and it is still unfixed.
findings.fix: Reword both sentences to: 'no gate definition changed; four reviewed advisory ignores were added under the .cargo/audit.toml policy, signed off by the non-author PMAT-1548 quorum and this round.'

If the squash-merge carried this stale receipt instead of this round's receipt, the merge would have no agreed receipt.
findings.fix: Commit this round's receipt over the stale one, bound to the final head, before arming the squash-merge.

findings.fix: Set #1548's milestone and #1530's sub-issue link on GitHub, then re-sync.

The receipt itself shows CB-2115 went red again (141 findings) between the first sync and this one, because GitHub moved on. A new issue opened before the merge would make master red again.
findings.fix: Re-run `pmat comply check --checks CB-2113,CB-2115` right before arming the merge (or on master just after it) and append the output to the receipt.
